start.description: The date to count from, written YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: A date to count to, written YYYY-MM-DD: the answer gives the days, weeks and working days between.

add_days.description: Days to move from start (negative moves back). Working days when business_days is true.

add_months.description: Calendar months to move from start, applied before add_days; the day is kept, or the month's last day when it has fewer.

business_days.description: Count add_days as working days, Monday to Friday.
